plain.li: [ail:SporeCough] Spent the afternoon among the fungus and came in coughing, with a fine brown dust on my sleeves.
[ail:SporeCough] Woke up with a dry tickle in my throat. The bedroom smells of mushrooms when it rains.
[ail:FumeHeadache] Hauled stone all morning downwind of the seeps. My head has been pounding since noon.
[ail:FumeHeadache] The air shimmers over the pits in the heat. I stood in it too long, and now my head aches.

gloomy.li: [ail:SporeCough] Even the air here wants to grow in us.

plain.li: [ail:SporeCough] The cough has finally let go. I'm keeping a cloth over my face in the fields from now on.
[ail:FumeHeadache] My head is clear again. I'll do the heavy work upwind of the seeps next time.

cheerful.li: [ail:SporeCough] Took a deep breath this morning without coughing, then another one just to be sure!
